exposure: positive history of diabetes in family
previous positive history of gestational diabetes
cohort: 152 women with gestational diabetes attending antenatal clinics and maternity
finding: The study found that a positive history of diabetes in the family, previous gestational diabetes, and previous adverse obstetric history increased the chances of caesarean section delivery, while primary level of education, previous gestational diabetes, and previous adverse obstetric history increased the likelihood of fetal macrosomia.
